newsitem.title: USA: Cox to sell Sun City, Calif., cable system.
newsitem.headline: Cox to sell Sun City, Calif., cable system.

text.p: Cox Communications Inc on Wednesday said it signed a definitive agreement to sell its Sun City, California, cable television system to Mediacom LLC.
Financial details of the agreement were not disclosed. The deal is expected to close in the third quarter, pending legal and regulatory approvals.
The Sun City system, which serves about 10,000 basic customers, has been owned by Cox since its 1995 acquisition of Times Mirror Co's cable television business.

Mediacom, which is privately held, said it would add the Sun City system to its regional cluster in California. Mediacom currently provides cable television and Internet access service to 30,000 customers in California and Arizona.
Cox is among the largest U.S. cable television operators, serving more than 3.2 million customers.
